svg.text: LLM BENCHMARKING & POC ACCEPTANCE: AIPERF, VLLM BENCH, GUIDELLM & ANTI-GAMING PROTOCOL
Controlled Prefix-Tree + Log-Normal Trace Replay Cuts PoC-to-Prod Sizing Error to 2.8%
8x H200 PoC Validation: Tier 1 Identical-Prompt Loop (340% Error!) vs. Tier 2 Fixed-Length (62.4% Error) vs. Tier 4 (2.8% Error)
⛔ The 4 Classic LLM Benchmark Gaming Traps
1. Trap A: Repeating the Same Prompt String (`100%` Prefix Hit!):
• Sending `"Write an essay..."` 1,000x in `locust` hits `100%` Prefix
Cache, skipping Prefill compute and inflating QPS by `3.4x`!
2. Trap B: Fixed Input/Output Lengths (`1024 In / 512 Out` Exact):
• Artificially aligns batch finish times & hides `32K` long-prompt
Prefill-Decode interference (`62.4%` capacity error in prod!)
3. Trap C: Client-Side Buffered Tokenizer & Early `[EOS]` Stopping:
• Missing `--ignore-eos` lets quantized models stop early to fake E2EL
Tier 1 Naive Benchmark Loop Failure Impact:
• PoC-to-Production Capacity Prediction Error: 340.0%!
• Post-Launch Production SLA Incident Rate: 78.5%
• Monthly Mis-Sized Cluster Waste TCO: $285,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Tamper-Proof PoC Benchmark Protocol
1. Controlled Prefix-Tree Ratio (`--prefix-len` + Unique Suffixes):
• Explicitly sets shared system prefix (`e.g., 65%`) + unique
random token suffixes (`35%`) to match real production cache hits!
2. Poisson/Gamma Burst Arrival + Log-Normal Length Distribution:
• Replays real `Mean / P90 / P99` input/output variance with
`--ignore-eos` and server-synchronized SSE chunk timestamps!
3. Automated Dual-SLA Pareto Knee Sweep (`GuideLLM / AIPerf`):
• Sweeps RPS from `1..100` to find max QPS where `P95 TTFT & P99 ITL` pass
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• PoC-to-Production Capacity Prediction Error: Only 2.8%!
• Post-Launch SLA Incidents: 0.0% | Sweep Time: 0.8 hours
• Monthly Mis-Sizing Waste TCO: $12,000 (-95.8% reduction)
